notes: Covers the Chevrolet half-ton C10 (2WD) and K10 (4WD), including the C10 Big-10 and C10 Diesel series and the 1987 R10/V10 naming. Trims (Custom, Custom Deluxe, Cheyenne, Cheyenne Super 1973-74; Custom Deluxe, Scottsdale, Cheyenne, Silverado 1975-81; Custom Deluxe, Scottsdale, Silverado 1982-87, Cheyenne dropped 1982 per 73-87chevytrucks.com) did not change engine availability. Availability depends on series (C10, Big-10, Diesel, K10) and California. Not half-ton engines: the 292 six (brochure spec tables for 1973-1975 and 1977-1987 list it only for 20/30 series; the one exception is California C10/F44 in 1976); the 400 and 454 after 1979 (1980 brochure: 'Not Available' in light-duty; Wikipedia: 454 dropped below 8,501 lb GVWR for 1980); the 305 in the K10 before 1981 (1978 4-Wheelers brochure: 305 only in the 4WD Blazer/Suburban); and the C10 350 in 1981-1986 (brochures, Wikipedia and EPA agree). The 1976 GM VIN card lists a 305 (140 hp), but the Sept 1975 pickup brochure does not offer it. Chevrolet, Wikipedia and 73-87chevytrucks.com date the truck 305 to 1977. The 1973 VIN card gives the 292 130 hp; later GM literature gives 120. All HP figures are SAE net half-ton ratings (light-duty emissions, 49-state) from the Chevrolet brochure for that year. Heavier-series and California ratings are in the notes. GM VIN data cards cover all light-duty trucks, so they confirm an engine was sold that year, not that the half-ton offered it. All GM material (Chevrolet and GMC brochures, VIN cards) counts as ONE source; independent_sources = number of distinct groups (GM, Wikipedia, EPA, NHRA, Flory, 73-87chevytrucks.com, Drivingline). Flory's book has year-by-year Chevrolet engine tables (net hp, VIN code, RPO, price by series); it was read through Google Books search snippets, not full pages. RPO codes are given only where GM literature prints an 'engine ordering code' (1979 on). For 1983 the GMC twin brochure is used because no 1983 Chevrolet pickup brochure is archived. Not used: Hagerty buyer's guide (403), forums, valuation and listing sites.
